issues.message: Deprecated module legacy_transform remains active or referenced.
issues.safe_alternative: Replace the deprecated module through a reviewed candidate graph version.

issues.message: Module legacy_transform references unknown external contract rule.missing.
issues.safe_alternative: Resolve the reference against an immutable supplied catalog before evaluation.

issues.message: Module orphan_transform is unreachable from every graph entry.
issues.safe_alternative: Connect the module through an explicit typed edge or remove it in a candidate version.

issues.message: Module prepare can run upstream of its prerequisite evaluate.
issues.safe_alternative: Reorder the graph so every prerequisite is strictly upstream.

issues.message: Modules evaluate, prepare contain a prerequisite cycle.
issues.safe_alternative: Break the prerequisite cycle in a new candidate graph.

issues.message: Prerequisite evaluate is not upstream of prepare.
issues.safe_alternative: Add an explicit prerequisite-to-dependent route or remove the declaration.

issues.message: Bounded loop module retry has no explicit non-loop route to an exit.
issues.safe_alternative: Add an explicit exhaustion or success route from the loop to a reachable exit.

issues.message: The diagnostic policy requires an explicit evidence-binding validation gate.
issues.safe_alternative: Insert a validation module with explicit required or produced evidence contracts.

issues.message: The diagnostic policy requires an authorized human decision gate.
issues.safe_alternative: Insert an append-only authorized human accept, reject, or defer decision module.

issues.message: Module retry cannot reach a declared graph exit.
issues.safe_alternative: Add an explicit fail-closed route to an exit or remove the dead branch.

issues.message: Write-capable module irreversible_write has no upstream validation boundary.
issues.safe_alternative: Move the write after an explicit validation gate in a new candidate graph.

issues.message: Task contract rejected the graph with ADAPTER_SIDE_EFFECT_UNAUTHORIZED.
issues.safe_alternative: Use a graph whose budgets, ports, and side effects satisfy the supplied task contract.

issues.message: Fallback path from evidence_validation has no non-fallback route to an exit.
issues.safe_alternative: Add a bounded fail-closed continuation from the fallback target to a declared exit.

issues.message: Modules evidence_validation, experiment_and_evidence form a cycle without an explicit bounded LOOP edge.
issues.safe_alternative: Replace the back edge with an explicit bounded loop contract or break the cycle.
